title: Merchant intelligence v1
description: Manually mirrored Rust-owned merchant/2 request/result. Canonical Money is signed-i64 decimal-string minor units; semantic evidence never establishes transaction identity, monetary relationships, authority, or execution. Cross-field/UTF-8/timezone constraints noted in $comment are additionally enforced by Rust/Zod boundaries.

OpaqueId.$comment: Rust and Zod additionally bound UTF-8 bytes to 256.

Text.$comment: Rust and Zod additionally bound UTF-8 bytes to 4096.

NonemptyText.$comment: Rust and Zod additionally bound UTF-8 bytes to 4096.

TimeZone.$comment: Explicit IANA zone, additionally validated against the runtime timezone database by Zod.

MerchantSourceAdmission.$comment: Runtime validation requires expiresAt > capturedAt, truncatedCount <= originalTransactionCount, and unique accountCoverage.accountId.

MerchantTransaction.$comment: Runtime validation requires child parentId=occurrenceId, or nonchild occurrenceId=id. Contradictory repeated source IDs fail; identical repetitions preserve source facts.

NativeRuleJson.description: Bounded opaque canonical JSON, preserving unsupported native rule semantics.
NativeRuleJson.$comment: Rust and Zod additionally enforce at most 10000 nodes and depth 32, counting the root at depth zero; strings and keys are bounded to 4096 UTF-8 bytes.

Rule.description: Canonical opaque native-rule JSON. Unsupported semantics produce explicit abstention, not source payload stripping.

MerchantCalendar.$comment: Runtime validation requires coverageStart <= coverageEnd. Unknown jurisdiction is valid, never inferred from currency.

ScheduleLiquidityFact.description: Existing canonical source schedule: preserves unknown/approximate/range precision and nullable recurrence options without inventing observed statistics.

MerchantAnalysisRequest.description: Already-authorized immutable merchant/2 source capture. Optional selection omission stays omitted; full aggregates retain all admitted observations.

MerchantCategoryHistoryEntry.$comment: Rust/Zod require count = ledgerCount + correctionCount and firstDate <= lastDate; a verified correction replaces the ledger outcome, never adds a second observation.

MerchantCategoryHistory.description: Full admitted outcome totals and endpoints, independent of bounded category/evidence samples; selected category first, then count descending and category ID ascending.
MerchantCategoryHistory.$comment: Rust/Zod require unique category IDs, categoryCount <= totalCount, truncated iff entries.length < categoryCount, and sampled sum < totalCount when truncated or exact total otherwise.

MerchantAlternative.description: Exact competing current evidence; authoritative categories before ranked history, no invented numeric confidence.

MerchantRuleCandidate.description: Stable native payee ID advice only, not a native rule payload or action permission.
MerchantRuleCandidate.$comment: Rust/Zod require supportCount = consistencyNumerator <= consistencyDenominator and numerator*100 >= denominator*90.

MerchantNativeRuleBlock.$comment: Structural shared block; valid-scalar IDs sorted strictly. Generic legacy has no merchant-only ID/count cap. Merchant result runtime additionally enforces ID UTF8<=256 and global ID count<=100000/disjoint.

MerchantNativeRulePart.$comment: Frozen literal posting; overlaps across parts are intentional. Runtime checks strictly increasing indexes and references to present blocks.

MerchantNativeRuleSet.$comment: categoryPart intersect (OR-union union four-field AND-intersection), fields payeeId/payeeName/accountId/categoryId. AND [] means no contribution; an empty operand canonicalizes the whole AND to [] only after original refs/order/closure validate. Runtime checks used sets and nonempty classified witnesses without bulk union materialization.

MerchantNativeRuleClassification.description: Complete surviving uncategorized native rule result referencing the shared result table, independent of selected explanations; rule IDs are never truncated.

MerchantCategoryClassification.description: Complete actionable non-native category targets, independent of explanation pages. payeeId is resolver-selected identity, never a replacement for actual native predicate fields.

MerchantOccurrenceDistribution.description: Every contiguous period (including zeros), occurrence-count histogram, and reduced exact average over full eligible observations.

MerchantOccurrenceDistributionWeek.$comment: Runtime validation also rejects ISO week 53 in years that have only 52 weeks.

firstDate.description: Earliest date across all admitted observations; never inferred from bounded samples.

lastDate.description: Latest date across all admitted observations; never inferred from bounded samples.

MerchantRecurrence.$comment: Runtime validation additionally requires minimumAmount.currency=maximumAmount.currency=currency and minimumAmount.minorUnits <= maximumAmount.minorUnits.

MerchantSuggestionPage.$comment: Runtime validation additionally requires returned <= eligibleCandidates.

nativeRuleParts.$comment: Derived <=13*T referenced part ceiling at merchant T<=250000; runtime uses actual used set count. No source M=O(rule-count) assumption.

nativeRuleClassifications.$comment: Rust/Zod additionally enforce unique transactionId across rows and ruleSetIndex < nativeRuleSets.length.

categoryClassifications.$comment: Rust/Zod enforce unique transaction IDs disjoint from native classifications and account/category membership in the admitted source manifests.

MerchantAnalysisResult.description: Explainable nonmutating findings, preserving source dependencies and independent observed/scheduled facts. Optional page omission stays omitted.
